newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Crown sees more international growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Crown sees more international growth.

text.p: Casino owner Crown Ltd said on Thursday it expected greater growth from its international market in the six months to June 30, compared with the first half of the 1996/97 year.

"While Crown's international business increased 70 percent over the previous corresponding half year period, greater growth is expected in the second half of this financial year given the seasonal timing of the major new year and national holidays throughout Asia," Crown said.

"We will expect to do substantially better in the next six month as we normally because of the seasonal factors, such as Asian holiday period," Crown spokesman Gary O'Neill told Reuters. O'Neill said Asian high rollers are increasing choosing to bet their luck at Crown rather than casinos in Las Vegas, still the premium destination for the region's biggest gamblers.

"We expect that after 12 months of trading in our new Southbank premises revenue from Asia will account for probably more than 60 percent," he said. Crown earlier reported a 65.7 percent rise in half year net profit to A$30.12 million.
O'Neill said revenue from Asian gamblers, which mainly come from Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Hong Kong, accounts for about 30 percent of Crown's income and is trending higher.

Crown said the construction of the permanment casino, also known as the Southbank Entertainment complex, is expected to open around April 1997. It said tenancies for the new complex were now being finalised.

"Forward bookings for the conference and ballroom facilities and for accommodation in the Crown Towers Hotel are strong, with substantial interest being generated in domestic and international markets," Crown said.
Crown is about 31 percent owned by Hudson Conway Ltd . Crown shares closed four cents up at A$2.70. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
